draft.threads_post:
OpenAI is testing a new feature called Private Inference.

It allows companies to run queries on its most powerful models without OpenAI being able to access the data. The goal is to let organizations use top models for sensitive work.

Would you trust OpenAI's privacy promise, or keep sensitive data in-house?
